records.name: Gilda Fineprint
records.biography_en: Gilda Fineprint booked a place with The Complimentary Demonstration. I came for the butter. The incident report lists small wrapped butter brick and curled blank receipt as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I came for the butter.
